plugin_codegen.title: Code Generator
plugin_codegen.description: Free code generator: read an existing business table or define a new one, generate a Go module and frontend pages from a recommended config, preview them, then download a zip

tables.name: Table
tables.hint: Pick an existing business table, or create one here (the package includes migrations for all three engines)
tables.emptyHint: The generator only reads business tables — framework tables (sys_) and plugin tables (plg_) are excluded. Create one here, or create it in your database and refresh.
tables.loadFailedHint: Check the network, or make sure the code generator plugin is enabled, then retry.

define.title: New business table
define.description: Structure only: the package includes mysql / mariadb / postgres migrations and the table is created on restart; the plugin never writes to the database
define.name: Table name
define.nameHint: The biz_ prefix is added automatically; the module name defaults to the name without it
define.migrationHint: Use the next number in your project's migrations/business
define.tenantHint: Adds tenant_id; rows are scoped per tenant
define.softDeleteHint: Adds deleted_at; deletes only mark rows
define.pendingHint: Table {{table}} does not exist yet: the three migrations in the package create it on restart.
define.errName: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, up to 48 characters (the biz_ prefix is added for you)
define.errMigration: Migration number must be 1-4 digits and greater than 0
define.errFieldName: Field names use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter
define.errReserved: id / tenant_id / created_at / updated_at / deleted_at are system columns and cannot be field names
define.errLength: Length must be an integer between 1 and 4000
define.errDict: Dict codes use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter

config.moduleHint: Lowercase letter first, then letters and digits; used as the Go package, the frontend folder and the i18n namespace
config.goModuleHint: The module in your project's go.mod; leave it empty to read this project's go.mod

shape.plain: Plain (explicit ID; the current tenant is filled on create when tenant_id exists)

col.name: Column
col.showSystemHint: System columns (id, tenant_id, timestamps) are generated automatically and need no configuration here

preview.pick: Pick a file on the left

notes.import_line: Add one blank import to internal/modules/modules.go; rebuild and restart to seed the menu (or tick auto-register when writing to the project):
notes.migration: Three migrations are included; drop them into migrations/business with your project's number and restart to create the table:
notes.null_zero: The table already exists, so no migration is generated; NULL columns are read as zero values and written back as zero values.

saved.title: Saved configs
saved.name: Config name
saved.saveHint: Saving with the same name updates it. Only the table/definition and column config are stored; code is always rendered fresh.
saved.saved: Config "{{name}}" saved — load it any time from Saved configs
saved.deletedPartial: Deleted {{deleted}} of {{total}} config(s) (the rest may already be gone)

install.title: Write to project
install.desc: Writes the generated files into the project root (the backend working directory; override with the NEXADMIN_ROOT environment variable; the directory must contain go.mod).
install.overwriteHint: By default only new files are written: existing ones are skipped and listed one by one in the receipt.
install.registerHint: Adds one blank import inside the marker block of internal/modules/modules.go so routes and menus take effect after a restart; does nothing if it is already registered.
install.restartHint: Rebuild and restart the backend afterwards. Drop new-table migrations into migrations/business and they apply on restart.
install.registerDone: Added the module's blank import to internal/modules/modules.go.
install.registerAlready: internal/modules/modules.go already imports this module; nothing was written.
install.registerNoFile: internal/modules/modules.go was not found, so the module was not registered; add the blank import manually as shown on the preview page.
install.registerNoMarkers: internal/modules/modules.go has no nexadmin:modules marker block, so the module was not registered; add the blank import manually.
install.registerFailed: Module registration failed ({{error}}). Files were written; add the blank import manually as shown on the preview page.

sub.title: Master-detail (optional)
sub.hint: Pick an existing table as the detail table: it needs a BIGINT *_id column pointing at the main table. Detail rows are saved with the master in one transaction (rewritten in full on every save; IDs are regenerated server-side).
sub.fkRequired: Pick the detail table's foreign-key column
sub.treeReject: A tree table cannot be a detail table

done.title: Next steps
done.description: Unzip into the project root, then:

errors.module: Use lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, up to 31 characters
